title: MCCS Car & Bike Show + Block Party

breadcrumb.label: MCCS Car & Bike Show + Block Party

intro: Two beloved events, one epic celebration! The fan-favorite Summer Bash has leveled up and transformed into the ultimate Block Party — and this year, it's joining forces with our Car & Bike Show for a combo you won't want to miss.

sections.heading: Event Details
sections.markdown:
**Date & Time:** April 25 | 10AM-2PM

**Location:** Bonnyman Bowling Center, Camp Lejeune

**Presented by:** Marine Chevrolet

Chrome, horsepower, and good vibes collide as car and bike enthusiasts roll in to show off their finest rides. Plus, we're bringing out our massive lineup of inflatables to include bounce houses, water slides, obstacle courses, and more!

sections.heading: Experience a day filled with:
sections.markdown:
- An up-close look at the NAPA Auto Parts Funny Car
- Tools giveaway, courtesy of NAPA Auto Parts
- Vehicle and static displays
- Wet and dry inflatables
- Dedicated toddler area for small children
- Free hot dogs while supplies last
- Enter to win a 4-pack of NASCAR Hall of Fame tickets (located in Charlotte, NC)
- Live entertainment
- Resource tables
- Additional food will be available for purchase

**Car show participants must have a DoW ID card.**

sections.heading: Registration
sections.markdown:
**Registration fee includes shirt and swag bag.**

- Through Mar. 27 | Early Bird Registration | $20 per vehicle
- Mar. 28-Apr. 24 | Standard Registration | $25 per vehicle
- Apr. 25 | Day of Registration - $30 per vehicle

sections.heading: Awards
sections.markdown:
**Cars, Trucks, Jeeps**

- Best Classic, Muscle Car, Sports, SUV, Jeeps, Truck, Import, Domestic, Fitment, Theme
- Most Unique
- Decades – 60s and below, 70s, 80s, 90s, 00s, 10s
- People's Choice, Best Car Club, Best in Show

**Bikes**

- Best Sport, Cruiser, Antique (pre-1984)
- Bike of the Year
